### Module 04 — Machine Learning for Clinical Prediction

# Clinical Model Evaluation

***
**Learning objectives**
- Choose the right evaluation metric for imbalanced clinical outcomes
- Interpret AUC-ROC, Precision-Recall, Brier score, and net benefit together
- Plot and interpret calibration curves; apply Platt scaling and isotonic regression
- Compute Decision Curve Analysis (DCA) and net benefit at clinical thresholds
- Build a comprehensive evaluation report with confidence intervals

**Estimated time:** 2.5 hours | **Level:** Advanced | **Libraries:** `tidymodels`, `yardstick`, `pROC`, `ggplot2`

## 1. Setup, Dataset & Models

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(patchwork)
tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(42)

mod04_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod04")
dir.create(mod04_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
col_blue <- "#2563EB"; col_red <- "#DC2626"; col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_navy <- "#1E3A8A"
colors_m <- c("Logistic Reg" = col_green, "Random Forest" = col_blue, "Grad Boosting" = col_red)

auc_prob   <- function(y, p) yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
ap_prob    <- function(y, p) yardstick::pr_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
brier_prob <- function(y, p) mean((p - y)^2)

set.seed(42); N <- 3000
sig <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4); set.seed(99)
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18, 92))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
los_days <- as.integer(clip(round(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8)), 1, 30))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5 + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15))
hypertension <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.7 * b[, 1] - 0.2))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
obesity <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] - 0.8))
depression <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 4] - 1.4))
n_comorb <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd + ckd
set.seed(21)
glucose <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 105 + 15 * diabetes, 28), 50, 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 10), 2)
hba1c <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 6.5 + 0.8 * diabetes, 1.4), 4, 14), 1)
sbp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 128 + 12 * hypertension, 18), 80, 200), 0)
bmi <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 28 + 4 * obesity, 6), 15, 55), 1)
logit <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
            0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 +
            0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency") +
            0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid") +
            0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) +
            0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit))
df <- tibble(
  age, sex, payer, admit_type, los_days,
  diabetes, hypertension, hf, copd, ckd, obesity, depression, n_comorb,
  glucose, creatinine, hba1c, sbp, bmi, readmitted
)
df$los_gt7 <- as.integer(df$los_days > 7)
NUMERIC <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorb", "glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "sbp", "bmi")
BINARY <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "hf", "copd", "ckd", "obesity", "depression", "los_gt7")
CATEGORIC <- c("sex", "payer", "admit_type")
FEATURES <- c(NUMERIC, BINARY, CATEGORIC); TARGET <- "readmitted"

set.seed(42)
df_ml <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted = factor(readmitted, levels = c(0, 1)))
sp_te  <- initial_split(df_ml, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
df_tr_all <- training(sp_te); df_te <- testing(sp_te)
sp_cal <- initial_split(df_tr_all, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
df_tr2 <- training(sp_cal); df_cal <- testing(sp_cal)

rec <- recipe(readmitted ~ ., data = df_tr2) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_normalize(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(BINARY)) %>%
  step_impute_mode(all_of(CATEGORIC)) %>%
  step_dummy(all_of(CATEGORIC), one_hot = TRUE)
rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = df_tr2)
bake_x <- function(d) bake(rec_prep, new_data = d) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xtr_tbl <- bake_x(df_tr2); Xcal_tbl <- bake_x(df_cal); Xte_tbl <- bake_x(df_te)
Xtr <- as.matrix(Xtr_tbl); Xcal <- as.matrix(Xcal_tbl); Xte <- as.matrix(Xte_tbl)
y_tr2 <- as.integer(as.character(df_tr2$readmitted))
y_cal  <- as.integer(as.character(df_cal$readmitted))
y_te   <- as.integer(as.character(df_te$readmitted))

# Logistic regression (balanced weights)
w_lr <- ifelse(y_tr2 == 1, 0.5 / mean(y_tr2 == 1), 0.5 / mean(y_tr2 == 0))
lr <- glm(y ~ ., data = Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(y = y_tr2), family = binomial, weights = w_lr)

# Random forest
cw <- c("0" = 1 / mean(y_tr2 == 0), "1" = 1 / mean(y_tr2 == 1))
rf <- ranger(
  readmitted ~ ., data = Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_tr2, levels = c(0, 1))),
  probability = TRUE, num.trees = 200, max.depth = 10, class.weights = cw, seed = 42
)

# Gradient boosting via xgboost (parsnip analogue of GBM)
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(Xtr, label = y_tr2)
gb <- xgb.train(
  params = list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "auc",
                eta = 0.05, max_depth = 4, subsample = 0.8, seed = 42, verbosity = 0),
  data = dtrain, nrounds = 200, verbose = 0
)

fitted <- list("Logistic Reg" = lr, "Random Forest" = rf, "Grad Boosting" = gb)
probs <- list(
  "Logistic Reg"  = as.numeric(predict(lr, newdata = Xte_tbl, type = "response")),
  "Random Forest" = predict(rf, data = Xte_tbl)$predictions[, "1"],
  "Grad Boosting" = predict(gb, xgb.DMatrix(Xte))
)
cat("Models trained. Positive rate (test):", mean(y_te) * 100, "%\n")
```

## 2. AUC-ROC and Precision-Recall with Bootstrap CIs

```{r}
bootstrap_ci <- function(y_true, y_prob, metric_fn, n_boot = 1000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- length(y_true)
  scores <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    metric_fn(y_true[idx], y_prob[idx])
  })
  quantile(scores, c(0.025, 0.975))
}

summary_rows <- list()
roc_all <- list(); pr_all <- list()
for (name in names(probs)) {
  prob <- probs[[name]]
  auc  <- auc_prob(y_te, prob)
  ap   <- ap_prob(y_te, prob)
  brier <- brier_prob(y_te, prob)
  auc_ci <- bootstrap_ci(y_te, prob, auc_prob)
  ap_ci  <- bootstrap_ci(y_te, prob, ap_prob)
  summary_rows[[name]] <- tibble(
    Model = name, AUC = auc,
    `AUC 95%CI` = sprintf("%.3f–%.3f", auc_ci[1], auc_ci[2]),
    `Avg Prec` = ap,
    `AP 95%CI` = sprintf("%.3f–%.3f", ap_ci[1], ap_ci[2]),
    Brier = brier
  )
  roc_all[[name]] <- yardstick::roc_curve(
    tibble(truth = factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = prob),
    truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
  ) %>% mutate(Model = name, lab = sprintf("%s AUC=%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
                                           name, auc, auc_ci[1], auc_ci[2]))
  pr_all[[name]] <- yardstick::pr_curve(
    tibble(truth = factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = prob),
    truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
  ) %>% mutate(Model = name, lab = sprintf("%s AP=%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
                                           name, ap, ap_ci[1], ap_ci[2]))
}

p_roc <- ggplot(bind_rows(roc_all), aes(1 - specificity, sensitivity, colour = Model)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colors_m) +
  labs(x = "1-Specificity", y = "Sensitivity",
       title = "ROC Curves with Bootstrap 95% CI") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_pr <- ggplot(bind_rows(pr_all), aes(recall, precision, colour = Model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(y_te), colour = col_red, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colors_m) +
  labs(x = "Recall", y = "Precision", title = "Precision-Recall Curves") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_roc + p_pr
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "roc_pr_curves.png"), width = 15, height = 6, dpi = 120)
print(bind_rows(summary_rows) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))))
```

## 3. Calibration Assessment & Recalibration

```{r}
calib_bins <- function(y, p, n_bins = 10) {
  tibble(y = y, p = p) %>%
    mutate(bin = ntile(p, n_bins)) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(mean_pred = mean(p), frac_pos = mean(y), .groups = "drop")
}

platt_calibrate <- function(p_fit, y_fit, p_new) {
  cal <- glm(y ~ p, data = tibble(y = y_fit, p = p_fit), family = binomial)
  as.numeric(predict(cal, newdata = tibble(p = p_new), type = "response"))
}
iso_calibrate <- function(p_fit, y_fit, p_new) {
  ord <- order(p_fit)
  iso <- isoreg(p_fit[ord], y_fit[ord])
  sf  <- as.stepfun(iso)
  pmin(pmax(sf(p_new), 0), 1)
}

calib_plots <- imap(probs, function(prob, name) {
  orig   <- calib_bins(y_te, prob)
  plat_p <- platt_calibrate(prob, y_te, prob)
  iso_p  <- iso_calibrate(prob, y_te, prob)
  d <- bind_rows(
    orig %>% mutate(method = "Uncalibrated"),
    calib_bins(y_te, plat_p) %>% mutate(method = "Platt (sigmoid)"),
    calib_bins(y_te, iso_p)  %>% mutate(method = "Isotonic")
  )
  brier_orig  <- brier_prob(y_te, prob)
  brier_platt <- brier_prob(y_te, plat_p)
  ggplot(d, aes(mean_pred, frac_pos, colour = method, shape = method)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
    geom_point(size = 2) + geom_line() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Uncalibrated" = colors_m[[name]],
                                   "Platt (sigmoid)" = "#D97706",
                                   "Isotonic" = "#7C3AED")) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.95,
             label = sprintf("Brier: %.3f→%.3f", brier_orig, brier_platt),
             hjust = 0, size = 3) +
    labs(x = "Mean predicted", y = "Fraction positives", title = name, colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
})

calib_plots[[1]] + calib_plots[[2]] + calib_plots[[3]] +
  plot_annotation(title = "Calibration plots — before and after recalibration")
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "calibration.png"), width = 16, height = 5, dpi = 120)
```

## 4. Decision Curve Analysis (DCA) — Net Benefit

```{r}
net_benefit <- function(y_true, y_prob, threshold) {
  y_pred <- as.integer(y_prob >= threshold)
  tp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_true == 1)
  fp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_true == 0)
  n  <- length(y_true)
  odds <- threshold / (1 - threshold)
  (tp - fp * odds) / n
}

thresholds <- seq(0.01, 0.50, length.out = 100)
dca <- imap_dfr(probs, function(prob, name) {
  tibble(threshold = thresholds,
         nb = map_dbl(thresholds, ~ net_benefit(y_te, prob, .x)),
         Model = name)
})
nb_all <- tibble(
  threshold = thresholds,
  nb = map_dbl(thresholds, ~ net_benefit(y_te, rep(1, length(y_te)), .x)),
  Model = "Treat all"
)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = dca, aes(threshold, nb, colour = Model), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = nb_all, aes(threshold, nb), colour = "grey20",
            linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colors_m) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.50), ylim = c(-0.05, 0.15)) +
  labs(x = "Threshold probability", y = "Net benefit per patient",
       title = "Decision Curve Analysis (area above 'Treat all' and 'Treat none' = clinical utility)")
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "dca.png"), width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 120)
cat("DCA interpretation:\n")
cat("  Treat all  = refer every patient regardless of model\n")
cat("  Treat none = refer no patient\n")
cat("  Model curve above both lines at a given threshold = model adds clinical value\n")
cat("  Choose threshold that matches your clinical tradeoff (e.g. intervention cost vs harm of missing)\n")
```

## 5. Threshold Selection for Clinical Deployment

```{r}
best_prob <- probs[["Grad Boosting"]]
roc_df <- pROC::roc(y_te, best_prob, quiet = TRUE)
fpr <- 1 - roc_df$specificities
tpr <- roc_df$sensitivities
thrs <- roc_df$thresholds
# pROC thresholds are in decreasing score order; replace Inf/-Inf
thrs[is.infinite(thrs)] <- ifelse(thrs[is.infinite(thrs)] > 0, 1, 0)

pr_df <- yardstick::pr_curve(
  tibble(truth = factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = best_prob),
  truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
)
precision_v <- pr_df$precision
recall_v    <- pr_df$recall
thrs_pr     <- pr_df$.threshold
thrs_pr[is.infinite(thrs_pr)] <- 1

# Three threshold strategies
youden_thr <- thrs[which.max(tpr - fpr)]
sens80_idx <- which(tpr >= 0.80)
thr_sens80 <- if (length(sens80_idx)) thrs[sens80_idx[1]] else 0.5
prec40_idx <- which(precision_v >= 0.40)
thr_prec40 <- if (length(prec40_idx)) thrs_pr[prec40_idx[1]] else 0.5

thresholds_clinical <- c(
  "Youden's J (balanced)" = youden_thr,
  "Sensitivity≥0.80"      = thr_sens80,
  "Precision≥0.40"        = thr_prec40
)

cat(sprintf("%-30s %10s %8s %8s %8s %8s\n",
            "Strategy", "Threshold", "Sens", "Spec", "PPV", "NPV"))
cat(strrep("-", 70), "\n")
for (strategy in names(thresholds_clinical)) {
  thr <- as.numeric(thresholds_clinical[[strategy]])
  y_pred <- as.integer(best_prob >= thr)
  tp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_te == 1); fp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_te == 0)
  tn <- sum(y_pred == 0 & y_te == 0); fn <- sum(y_pred == 0 & y_te == 1)
  sens <- tp / (tp + fn); spec <- tn / (tn + fp)
  ppv  <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else 0
  npv  <- if ((tn + fn) > 0) tn / (tn + fn) else 0
  cat(sprintf("%-30s %10.3f %8.3f %8.3f %8.3f %8.3f\n",
              strategy, thr, sens, spec, ppv, npv))
}
cat("\n")
cat("Clinical guidance:\n")
cat("  High sensitivity = fewer missed readmissions (prefer when intervention is cheap/safe)\n")
cat("  High precision   = fewer unnecessary interventions (prefer when intervention is costly/harmful)\n")
```

## 6. Knowledge Check
1. AUC=0.78 but Avg Precision=0.32. Why the large gap, and which is more informative here?
2. The calibration plot shows the RF overestimates risk at high probabilities. What recalibration approach should you use?
3. At threshold=0.20, GB model has net benefit > treat all. What does this mean clinically?
4. A colleague insists on maximising AUC. Name two scenarios where this would be the wrong objective.
5. Apply isotonic regression recalibration on the validation set and re-evaluate Brier score on the test set.

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — isotonic recalibration on val → test
pred_val <- list(
  "Logistic Reg"  = as.numeric(predict(lr, newdata = Xcal_tbl, type = "response")),
  "Random Forest" = predict(rf, data = Xcal_tbl)$predictions[, "1"],
  "Grad Boosting" = predict(gb, xgb.DMatrix(Xcal))
)
for (name in names(fitted)) {
  prob_val  <- pred_val[[name]]
  prob_test <- probs[[name]]
  prob_recal <- iso_calibrate(prob_val, y_cal, prob_test)
  brier_orig  <- brier_prob(y_te, prob_test)
  brier_recal <- brier_prob(y_te, prob_recal)
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: Brier %.4f → %.4f (change: %+.4f)\n",
              name, brier_orig, brier_recal, brier_recal - brier_orig))
}
```
